turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm looking into RoboCasa365 today. It's interesting how RoboCasa365 reuses 83 of the original RoboCasa composite tasks and expands with new activity categories.
That's a significant expansion. Keeping the core composite tasks while broadening the activity scope is a smart move for benchmarking.
Yeah. Also, did you see the weather forecast for the weekend? It looks like rain.
Yes, I saw that. It might be a good time to stay indoors and focus on data analysis.
True. I also need to fix that bug in my script later.
Let me know if you need help debugging it.
Lloyd, I read a paper today on Jamba-1.5. It says Jamba 1.5 Large achieves competitive quality with 2-5x throughput gains at long context compared to pure Transformers.
Those throughput gains are impressive for long-context tasks. The hybrid architecture seems to be paying off.
Definitely. I also ordered a new monitor today. It should arrive next week.
Nice. A new monitor always helps with productivity.
I hope so. I need more screen real estate for these papers.
Understood. Let me know when it arrives.
